title: Unsupported binary operators pass checking
notes: Fixed on main by c310b9783d756a88360469f2f8f016ff866bff1c: unsupported symbolic/bitwise binary operators are rejected by the Moss frontend with focused negative regressions. Retained as historical classification evidence.

title: Vector[Trait]() passes frontend check but fails native compilation
notes: Fixed on main by c310b9783d756a88360469f2f8f016ff866bff1c: trait types are rejected in concrete collection element positions because Moss v0.1 has no runtime trait objects or dynamic dispatch. Retained as historical classification evidence.

title: Failure/precondition mechanism for user code is undocumented
notes: Ordinary user-code failure and precondition semantics will be designed with recoverable error propagation and supervision in Phase 21; removed from Phase 15.15 scope.

title: Untyped parameter field access monomorphizes function to first caller type
notes: Phase 15.15 semantic direction settled; implementation pending: field access on an untyped parameter must be rejected with a Moss diagnostic, not inferred as a structural field requirement or frozen to the first caller. Require a concrete parameter type or an explicit method contract. Implementation and regressions remain pending. The broader policy for untyped method calls is separately under discussion.

title: Untyped collection indexing fails checking with container error
notes: Per-call specialization for built-in indexing is proposed in docs/PHASE_15_15_INDEXING_PROPOSAL.md. User-defined indexing is a separate Phase 15.15 workstream (EXPRESS-008), pending opt-in syntax design.

title: for i in range accepted by checker but native lowering loses induction binding
notes: Phase 15.14: range bounds are now materialized into typed let-locals before the for-loop to prevent pipeline block-expressions from being misparsed as the loop body by rustc. Regression: tests/swarm_066_for_range_lowering.moss. Fast Debug for-iteration limitation tracked separately.

title: Compiler assertion abort on pipeline reduce with Map accumulator
notes: Phase 15.14 follow-up: checker retains WRITE observations even when the final parameter effect is CONSUME; native owned-binding mutability follows that checked fact. Indexed Map mutation inside if/while and through a helper passes native and Fast Debug. Built-in Map read effects and the functional IR assertion remain intact. Full make gates passed.

title: Nested generic specialization fails in Rust lowering backend
notes: Phase 15.14 follow-up: checked control-flow join environments are retained by exact static specialization context and required by native lowering. Branch-created locals in both specialization discovery orders call matching concrete inner helpers. Native, Fast Debug, generated-call assertions, and full make gates passed.

title: Unqualified sibling callable argument across modules fails native lowering
notes: Fixed in Phase 15.14: statically known callable references retain their canonical resolved identity across explicit module boundaries and native lowering for both unqualified sibling syntax and explicitly qualified syntax, with lexical/control-flow aware local tracking covering branch/loop shadowing and body-locals in trailing result expressions, verified with Fast Debug.

title: Formatter rejects valid statements whose expression begins with an opening parenthesis
notes: Fixed in Phase 15.14: canonicalize_code_spacing checks for space keywords before '(' allowing parenthesized arithmetic, comparisons, nested groupings, and calls. Verified with idempotence and malformed grouping tests in tests/tooling/check_swarm_032_formatter_parentheses.py.

title: effects reports a pure loop helper as divergent/unresolved yet it is accepted as a domain initializer
notes: Fixed in Phase 15.14: observable effect analysis enforces conservative bounded loop proofs (bound invariant, no induction-variable dependency, no body mutation of variables used by the bound) and marks pop/pop_front as may_fail; domain state initializers authoritatively enforce side-effect-freedom, bringing semantic queries and domain initialization into agreement.

title: No project-wide Fast Debug test discovery/orchestration
notes: Fixed in Phase 15.14: added project-wide Fast Debug test discovery and orchestration via moss test --interp and margo test --interp [--trace], supporting multi-file and multi-module test execution, filtering, and trace emission without rustc. Verified with tests/tooling/check_swarm_039_project_fast_debug_tests.py.

title: Multi-file project diagnostics misattribute error source file to root or first module
notes: Fixed in Phase 15.14: preserved physical source file provenance across parsing, module composition, semantic checking, and structured JSON diagnostics, correctly attributing errors in non-root module files. Verified with tests/tooling/check_swarm_059_diagnostic_provenance.py.

title: moss edit rename fails on module-qualified entities with EDIT_TARGET_AMBIGUOUS
notes: Fixed in Phase 15.14: moss edit rename resolves module-qualified entity selectors unambiguously and renames qualified/unqualified call sites and declarations without EDIT_TARGET_AMBIGUOUS while preserving ambiguity rejection for unqualified same-named entities. Verified with tests/tooling/check_swarm_060_qualified_rename.py.

title: Static callable parameters for ordinary functions
notes: Resolved by the stabilized static-callable-parameter path now covered by tests/swarm_048_callable_argument.moss: ordinary functions may accept statically known callable parameters and invoke them without runtime function objects or dynamic dispatch. Cross-module callable identity preservation remains separately tracked as SWARM-051.

title: No general explicit copy operation for nontrivial values
notes: Ownership-aware collection work needs a documented source operation meaning: give me a new owned value equivalent to x, especially for Strings, records, and Vector[Struct] values.

title: Core String manipulation surface
notes: Track the ordinary String operations realistic applications need, including length, character access, iteration, split, parse, and join; the exact API is intentionally undecided here.

title: Map deletion
notes: Map insertion, reads, and default lookup exist, but deletion is absent and workloads resorted to tombstones or alive flags.

title: Enums and tagged unions
notes: Translated workloads naturally wanted closed variants and token kinds instead of strings, integer tags, or records; syntax and representation are not designed in this task.

title: Static Self or covariant trait return
notes: Structural tree abstractions want a static-polymorphism mechanism equivalent to a trait method returning Self; this is not a request for runtime dynamic dispatch or recursion.

title: Recoverable error propagation
notes: Track ordinary recoverable error propagation or Result-like semantics for the existing later Error Propagation & Supervision phase. Do not design exception or Result semantics here.

title: Explicit static indexing contract for user-defined types
notes: Separate Phase 15.15 indexing workstream. Per-call static specialization agreed; explicit opt-in source spelling, read/write operations, key/result types and ambiguity rules need a design checkpoint before implementation. Proposal: docs/PHASE_15_15_INDEXING_PROPOSAL.md.
